# U42: Anyone opens the inbox with no sign-in; an admin opens a markup, toggles the drawing, marks it in hand and undoes it, opens its GitHub issue and keeps the link, and marks it fixed; then marks a piece of feedback in hand. A member reads it all with no way to change a status, and /inbox opens it

- **Belongs to:** the Feedback module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `MARKUP`, `MARKUP-INBOX`, `FEEDBACK-INBOX`, `INBOX-TRIAGE`
- **Budget:** at most 23 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `progress` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/` in the demo, on a build whose database can’t be reached.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U42

## Steps and checks

- **Check:** It fails if U42 needs the build with a database address (DOWN).
- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- A database for the build whose database never answers (`fakeSupabase(p.context())`).
- _Note:_ Amara, an admin (only admins triage, Lane 12 Nov), marks up Home in the demo (her markup goes to the database, marked demo), with the shortcut.
- Go to `/` in the demo, on a build whose database can’t be reached.
- Sends a markup of Home from the demo, as the person on this page (`sendHomeMarkup(p, device, 'The week strip should say which week it is')`).
- _Note:_ The inbox, a section of Workspace: open, no sign-in and no token to paste.
- Go to `/feedback` in the demo, on a build whose database can’t be reached.
- **Check:** An Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`) shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the input, or the input (`input[type=email], input[type=password]`) in the inbox (`#inbox`) is not there and the words “Sign in” in the inbox (`#inbox`) is not there (else: the inbox still asks to sign in or for a token).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `await row.locator('.mk-status').innerText() === 'New' && (await row.innerText()).includes('The week strip should say which week it is') && (await row.innerText()).includes('the demo')`, where `const inbox = p.locator('#inbox')`; `const row = inbox.locator('.ibx-row').first()`. Else it says: the markup is not listed as New, with its line and where it came from.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “inbox”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Connect Claude opens from the top: in the demo it says tokens are made in the real app, and gives the set-up.
- **Step.** Press the “Connect Claude” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “any token from it reads the demo’s markups too” is shown in the connect (`.connect`) in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `atTop && setUp && says && await see(connect, 'Pictures for Claude: ready').then(() => true, () => false)`, where `const inbox = p.locator('#inbox')`; `const connect = inbox.locator('.connect')`; `const atTop = await inbox.evaluate((el) => { const c = el.querySelector('.connect'); const l = el.querySelector('.ibx-list'); return !!c && !!l && !!(c.compareDocumentPosition(l) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING); })`; `const setUp = (await connect.getByLabel('Claude Code command', { exact: true }).inputValue()).includes('/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer gk_')`; `const says = await see(connect, 'any token from it reads the demo’s markups too').then(() => true, () => false)`. Else it says: Connect Claude at the top {atTop}, set-up {setUp}, says any token works {says}.
- Press the “Connect Claude” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Step.** Press the open Inbox item in an Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** The img in the mk layers (`.mk-layers img`) in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`) shows.
- **Step.** Press the “Show the drawing” field in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “markup”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Mark in hand: it leaves New and the next item (the feedback) opens; Undo puts the markup back as it was.
- **Step.** Press the “Mark in hand” button in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** The “Feedback:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`) shows.
- **Check:** “Marked in hand: “The week strip” is shown in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the inbox does not say what was just done).
- **Step.** Press the “Undo” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “New” is shown in the mark-up’s status line in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: Undo did not put the markup back to New).
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `db.markups[0].status === 'new' && db.patches.length === 2`, where `const { db } = await fakeSupabase(p.context())`. Else it says: after Undo the markup is {db.markups[0].status}, {db.patches.length} changes saved.
- **Step.** Press the “Mark in hand” button in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- _Note:_ In hand: open it there, say who marked it, open its GitHub issue and keep the link, then mark it fixed.
- On a phone an open item takes the screen: back to the list (and its tabs) first (`toInboxList(h, inbox)`, where `const inbox = p.locator('#inbox')`).
- **Step.** Press the “In hand” tab in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Step.** Press the open Inbox item in an Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “In hand” is shown in the mark-up’s status line in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: not marked in hand).
- **Check:** “Marked in hand by Amara Nwosu” is shown in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the markup does not say who marked it).
- _Note:_ The address the app opened. GitHub sends a browser that isn't signed in on to its sign-in page, with that address as return_to (a public repository does this since 8 Nov), so read it from there when it has.
- **Step.** Type “https://github.com/sconies/goals-app/issues/101” into the “Paste issue link” field in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Step.** Press the “Keep the link” button in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “sconies/goals-app/issues/101” is shown in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the issue link is not shown).
- **Step.** Press the “Mark fixed” button in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Step.** Press the “Mark fixed” button in the mk form (`.mk-form`) in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “Nothing is in hand.” is shown in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the fixed markup is still in hand).
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `drawn === 1 && hidden === 0 && link`, where `const { db } = await fakeSupabase(p.context())`; `const inbox = p.locator('#inbox')`; `const detail = inbox.getByRole('article', { name: /^Markup: / })`; `const drawn = await detail.locator('.mk-ink-layer').count()`; `const hidden = await detail.locator('.mk-ink-layer').count()`; `const [tab] = await Promise.all([p.context().waitForEvent('page'), h.click(detail.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open GitHub issue' }))])`; `const opened = new URL(tab.url())`; `const issue = opened.pathname === '/login' && opened.searchParams.get('return_to') ? new URL(opened.searchParams.get('return_to'), 'https://github.com') : opened`; `const m = db.markups[0]`; `` const link = issue.origin + issue.pathname === 'https://github.com/sconies/goals-app/issues/new' && /The week strip/.test(issue.searchParams.get('title') || '') && (issue.searchParams.get('body') || '').includes(`/feedback?markup=${m.id}`) ``. Else it says: drawing layer {drawn} then {hidden}; issue link {tab.url().slice(0, 160)}.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `` shared && db.signIns === 0 && db.pictureReads.includes(`${m.id}/screen.png`) && m.status === 'fixed' && m.fixed_in && m.issue_url === 'https://github.com/sconies/goals-app/issues/101' && m.status_by === 'Amara Nwosu' && db.patches.length === 5 ``, where `const { db } = await fakeSupabase(p.context())`; `const sent = db.markups[0]`; `` const shared = !!sent && sent.demo === true && db.issued.includes(sent.id) && ['screen.png', 'ink.png', 'thumb.jpg', 'marked.jpg'].every((x) => db.uploads.includes(`${sent.id}/${x}`)) && sent.route === '/' && !('status' in db.inserted[0]) ``; `const m = db.markups[0]`. Else it says: sent {shared}, sign-ins {db.signIns}, pictures {JSON.stringify(db.pictureReads)}, stored {worked out in the journey as `JSON.stringify({ status: m.status, fixed: m.fixed_in, issue: m.issue_url, by: m.status_by, patches: db.patches.length })`}.
- _Note:_ Feedback sent with a mood and a few words is in the same inbox, with the same states.
- On a phone an open item takes the screen: back to the list (and its tabs) first (`toInboxList(h, inbox)`, where `const inbox = p.locator('#inbox')`).
- **Step.** Press the “New” tab in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `await fbRow.locator('.mk-status').innerText() === 'New' && fbText.includes('The reason box is too small on a phone') && fbText.includes('Feedback') && fbText.includes('Mateo Silva, Acme')`, where `const inbox = p.locator('#inbox')`; `const fbRow = inbox.locator('.ibx-row').filter({ has: p.locator('.fb-item') }).first()`; `const fbText = await fbRow.innerText()`. Else it says: the feedback is not listed as New, with its words and who sent it: {fbText.replace(/\n/g, ' | ')}.
- **Step.** Press the open Inbox item in an Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`) with the fb item (`.fb-item`).
- **Step.** Press the “Mark in hand” button in the “Feedback:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “Nothing new.” is shown in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the inbox does not say there is nothing new).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `db.fbPatches.length === 1 && fp.status === 'in-hand' && fp.status_by === 'Amara Nwosu' && db.feedback[0].status === 'in-hand'`, where `const { db } = await fakeSupabase(p.context())`; `const fp = db.fbPatches[0] || {}`. Else it says: feedback stored {JSON.stringify(db.fbPatches)}.
- Close this browser.
- _Note:_ Rhea, not an admin, reads the same inbox from its guessed address (/inbox gave Page not found, 12 Nov), with a line saying only an admin changes a status, and no button or key to change one.
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- A database for the build whose database never answers (`fakeSupabase(q.context())`).
- Go to `/inbox` in the demo, on a build whose database can’t be reached.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/feedback”.
- **Check:** An Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`) shows.
- Press the ibx open in the ibx row (`.ibx-row .ibx-open`) in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “Only an admin can change the status of feedback.” is shown in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: a member is not told who changes a status).
- **Check:** It fails if a member is offered {buttons} ways to change a status.
